Virtual assistant support for legal practices

A legal virtual assistant keeps intake, matter files, approved research, deadlines and billing administration organised for the responsible lawyer.

Law firm intake support can log new enquiries, request approved documents and prepare a checklist for the responsible lawyer. We can also gather time entries and flag gaps for the person who checks the draft invoice and approves any changes.

Planning your support

A legal virtual assistant turns an enquiry into a review-ready file

In this fictional example, a potential client contacts a law firm by phone and email.

A document arrives later, but the firm has yet to clear the matter and a date in the correspondence needs confirmation. Law firm intake support keeps the information together so the lawyer can review it before accepting work or making a commitment.

  1. 01

    Collect the approved intake fields

    Use the firm’s intake script, note the source of the enquiry and link related messages without collecting more than the firm allows. Law firm intake support can request missing administrative details and put the record in the conflict and engagement review queue. Keep any promised callback time with the original contact.

  2. 02

    Prepare the file and flag dates for review

    A legal virtual assistant can index the documents, label the current version and record a date as pending confirmation. Separate consultation scheduling from any approval to proceed. Give the lawyer the original correspondence and an explicit question about dates or documents that need professional judgment.

  3. 03

    Record the decision and the next action

    Once the lawyer records the decision, update the approved matter status and the reminders the firm has authorised. Legal billing support can collect agreed time or expense records and prepare a separate draft pack. Leave external communications and billing issuance in their respective approval queues.

Where a legal virtual assistant needs a decision

Record the source, what you checked and who can decide. Keep blocked work visible until the next action changes.

A possible conflict appears

Law firm intake support can preserve the names and original request in the approved system and flag it for the designated reviewer. Hold further intake steps as instructed and avoid promising that the firm can accept the matter until the responsible lawyer confirms the next action.

A document contains an unconfirmed deadline

A legal virtual assistant can point the lawyer to the exact source and note that confirmation is pending. Keep the escalation visible and use the agreed urgent contact if the date is close. Apply calendar reminders only against the instruction the lawyer approves.

An invoice or time entry is disputed

Legal billing support can record the period, affected item, client question and supporting file. Prepare an issue summary for the billing owner. Keep the original ledger or time entry unchanged unless the authorised owner approves a correction.

Define the rules for law firm intake support

Law firm intake support rules

Provide the approved intake questions, secure submission route and script for consultations or follow-ups. Confirm which people and entities the firm needs for its own conflict review. Give one routine and one sensitive example, and say what information should stay out of a general log.

Matter files and calendar permissions

Agree which case folders, fields and calendars the legal virtual assistant can access. Set version naming and the rule for recording dates with their source and status. Name the person who confirms the date and the backup contact when a question cannot wait.

Legal billing support inputs

Provide the approved time-entry and expense fields, billing period and format for a review pack. Agree who can ask for missing entries and who owns decisions on rates, adjustments, client invoices or funds. Test a routine billing record and an exception separately.

Check files and legal billing support

Check an intake from first contact to review

Open a completed enquiry and verify the source, approved fields, latest status and owner. Look for duplicate contact records or a promised update without a date. Law firm intake support should give the reviewer enough context to act without asking the client for the same material twice.

Check the matter file and deadline source

Sample a saved document and a reminder. The legal virtual assistant should be able to point to the current file version and the instruction that confirms the date. Record any mismatch and ask the matter owner how to correct it.

Check the draft billing pack

Compare a few time and expense entries with the source and the agreed reporting period. Legal billing support can note missing fields, review status and the decision required. Keep any issue affecting client funds or invoice release with the authorised owner.

Make the next step clear

Enquiries awaiting a decision

Link the authorised intake record and capture the agreed next contact time. Follow up through the approved route once the lawyer has reviewed it.

Matter and document versions

Identify the current approved files, open document requests and their owners. Continue preparation without working from an outdated version.

Dates and reminders

Record the source and who confirmed each deadline or calendar entry. Review what is due soon and send questions to the matter owner.

Legal billing support

Keep the draft pack, period and open discrepancies with the billing reviewer. Confirm missing inputs and leave approval and issuance with the firm.

Set review windows for law firm intake support

Daily intake

Schedule a check for new enquiries, confirmations and unanswered requests. A legal virtual assistant can prepare an update for the lawyer showing matters awaiting conflict or engagement review. Keep the current callback and appointment status with each record.

Before a filing or hearing window

Ask the matter owner which dates and documents need a separate check. Use law firm intake support and matter administration to record approved reminders, document versions and outstanding signatures. Escalate changes to the lawyer through the agreed contact route.

Billing cycle

Use legal billing support to collect and review approved source entries before the cutoff. Identify which items depend on a decision or supporting record, then send the review packet to the billing owner in time for the firm’s approval process.

Review an open matter handover

Before a matter changes hands, compare the file list with the approved checklist. Identify missing documents, unanswered requests and reminders awaiting confirmation. Keep the correspondence available to the authorised reviewer, with its date and source intact. Explain what the client has been told and when the response is due. The receiving professional should be able to distinguish completed administration from a decision that still requires their judgment.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you book consultations?

Yes. Agree the permitted information to collect, approved availability and who clears engagement or conflict questions.

Can you organise matter documents?

We can index approved records, maintain version names and flag missing items within the firm’s workspace.

Who confirms legal deadlines?

The responsible legal professional confirms deadlines. We maintain the agreed tracker and reminders.

Can a legal virtual assistant prepare research?

A legal virtual assistant can compile approved sources and organise notes for the responsible professional to review and interpret.

Can you help prepare legal invoices?

We can organise time entries and draft billing inputs, then route the pack for review and issuance.

What happens if a caller needs legal advice?

We record the request and route it through your approved process to the responsible lawyer.
